notes: NAME FORM: the source row reads 'Dr. Naga Avinash Bonda'; AIG Hospitals and all other indexed sources publish him as 'Dr. Avinash Bonda' (Naga is a dropped first given name, a very common Telugu pattern). Surname Bonda plus the medical-oncology + AIG combination is unique in the index, so there is no ambiguity. Identity verified on four criteria: the AIG own doctor page https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-avinash-bonda (surfaced on the full-name query 'Naga Avinash Bonda medical oncology' restricted to aighospitals.com, and again on a separate query) plus his X bio self-describing as 'Medical and Hematooncologist at the Institute of Oncology, AIG Hospitals Hyderabad' - matching name + specialty (Medical Oncology) + hospital (AIG) + city (Hyderabad). Band is Medium, not High: AIG Hospitals is the only OFFICIAL source; ResearchGate, SciSpace and HexaHealth are corroborating only, and a self-run X account is self-published by definition. No healinindia.gov.in profile surfaced for him. NO CONTACT DETAILS RECORDED: no email, phone or LinkedIn appeared verbatim anywhere; nothing was constructed.
